attributes.description:
The base estimator from which the ensemble is grown.

.. versionadded:: 1.2
   `base_estimator_` was renamed to `estimator_`.
attributes.name: estimator_

attributes.description: Weights for each estimator in the boosted ensemble.
attributes.name: estimator_weights_

attributes.description:
Classification error for each estimator in the boosted
ensemble.
attributes.name: estimator_errors_

attributes.description:
The impurity-based feature importances if supported by the
``estimator`` (when based on decision trees).

Warning: impurity-based feature importances can be misleading for
high cardinality features (many unique values). See
:func:`sklearn.inspection.permutation_importance` as an alternative.
attributes.name: feature_importances_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Build a boosted classifier/regressor from the training set (X, y).

methods.name: score
methods.summary: Return :ref:`accuracy <accuracy_score>` on provided data and labels.

methods.name: set_fit_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``fit`` method.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

methods.name: set_score_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``score`` method.

methods.name: staged_decision_function
methods.summary: Compute decision function of ``X`` for each boosting iteration.

methods.name: staged_score
methods.summary: Return staged scores for X, y.

parameters.description:
The base estimator from which the boosted ensemble is built.
Support for sample weighting is required, as well as proper
``classes_`` and ``n_classes_`` attributes. If ``None``, then
the base estimator is :class:`~sklearn.tree.DecisionTreeClassifier`
initialized with `max_depth=1`.

.. versionadded:: 1.2
   `base_estimator` was renamed to `estimator`.
parameters.name: estimator

parameters.description:
The maximum number of estimators at which boosting is terminated.
In case of perfect fit, the learning procedure is stopped early.
Values must be in the range `[1, inf)`.
parameters.name: n_estimators

parameters.description:
Weight applied to each classifier at each boosting iteration. A higher
learning rate increases the contribution of each classifier. There is
a trade-off between the `learning_rate` and `n_estimators` parameters.
Values must be in the range `(0.0, inf)`.
parameters.name: learning_rate

parameters.description:
Controls the random seed given at each `estimator` at each
boosting iteration.
Thus, it is only used when `estimator` exposes a `random_state`.
Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state
parameters.type_doc: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None
